text: Ko onon yo ɓe gomɗimɓe Allah ɓe golliri sari'a Makko on, si faasiqiijo ardanii on e kabaaru fii yimɓe, haray tefee fii mun, haray on hawjiraali goongingol mo, fii wata on heɓor e yimɓe, sau majjeede huunde nden, waɗtiniron kon ko heɓiɗon e maɓɓe ɗon, ninsuɓe, tuma fenaande kumpital ngal laaɓani on.
